rules.title: Late repository-boundary consultation beside higher token use
rules.observed_relation_template: In {ordered} of {pairs} orderable run pairs, the run that first read {capability} after half its events recorded more output tokens than a run that read it earlier; {late} late and {early} early runs were compared.
rules.nearest_forbidden_claim: Late boundary consultation raises token spend. The recorded events support an association between two observations in this cohort, not a mechanism.

handoff.reason: Horos owns the reading boundary; a person may ask it whether earlier orientation output would change the observed association.

rules.title: Unchanged retries preceding an Elenchus handoff
rules.observed_relation_template: {runs} run(s) scheduled at least {attempts} retries of one unchanged capability before recording a handoff to {consumer}.
rules.nearest_forbidden_claim: Retrying without a change wastes the run. The recorded events support only that unchanged retries preceded the handoff in these runs.

handoff.reason: Elenchus owns failure triage; a person may ask it whether the retried capability deserved a cause-first path instead of repetition.
